ker(symmetriser) = Hom(G, F^x/(F^x)^2); at F^x = {+/-1} that is (Z/2)^d, so 2^d twists share one commutation form. rc404 (`#T1069`): this said 'share one bicharacter'. dim_alternating_bicharacters counts the LITERATURE's objects and is correct; the shared form itself is only a bicharacter at d = 1, 2 -- measured NOT bimultiplicative from d = 3 up (O 168/512).
